summary: Polish/regression frontend pass (iteration 11). All 16 polish items from the review request verified against the live preview URL on desktop (1920x1080) AND mobile (390x844). Admin login is fully scrubbed of seeded credential hints, Private Vault rebrand is live, mobile section spacing tightened to py-20, hero CTAs and Keystone submit button have active:scale-[0.97], onboarding modal inputs have the gold focus-glow + autoComplete attrs. Zero console errors aside from the expected 401 on the wrong-password test.
